newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh names new securities & exchange chief.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh names new securities & exchange chief.

text.p: Bangladesh on Sunday appointed Mohammad Abu Sayeed, a retired civil servant, as the new chief of the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), the official BSS news agency said, quoting a government announcement.
Sayeed's appointment followed the resignation of Harunur Rashid as head of the capital market watchdog late last month.
Rashid, also a retired bureaucrat, resigned on June 29 complaining of a lack of cooperation and support from the government in his efforts to reform the troubled capital market.

The stock market reacted adversely to the resignation of Rashid who drew praise by initiating tough legal action against some issuers and brokers found to have been involved in price manipulation by a recent inquiry.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange all share price index dropped 1.49 percent to 1,032.36 on Sunday, a working day in Bangladesh.
The government on Sunday also appointed Mohammad Sekender Ali, a career banker, as an advisor of the SEC.
